reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown argue leprosy spread only by contact, so the king could have conferred with Gehazi at a distance, perhaps at the gate or in a garden.

sides.snippet: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave to you, and to your seed forever.
sides.verseText: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave to you, and to your seed forever. He went out from his presence a leper [as white] as snow.

sides.snippet: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.
sides.verseText: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.
